Msty Claw

Beta

Give AI a task.
Let it run.

For hands-off task automation

Claw runs multi-step tasks with model access, tool use, and sandboxed folder-scoped execution on your machine.

Msty Nexus

Your central AI gateway.
Total AI control.

Msty Nexus is a central gateway for both local and online AI. Manage runtimes, provider models, presets, credentials, and secure app access in one place.

Connect Studio, Claw, scripts, and compatible clients through shared OpenAI-style and Anthropic-style gateway surfaces.

Msty Stack

Msty Stack gives your team a shared knowledge base of centrally managed Knowledge Stacks that keep AI responses grounded in the right context.

Pair it with Msty Nexus for inference, or bring your own. Msty Stack works with whatever inference setup your team uses.
